name: Graffito
description: Inhabits display systems — public screens, ad boards, transit schedules — and overwrites content with brief messages, symbols, or images. A digital graffiti artist.
observed_behavior: Replaces displayed content for 1-5 seconds with original imagery. Messages range from abstract patterns to pointed political commentary. Always reverts cleanly.
location: the Gray Zone, The Circuit, transit systems
story_hooks: Graffito's messages start containing specific warnings about upcoming security sweeps — someone is feeding it intel
